notes.title: Trump Kim Jong-un mode free update, 50% off sale!
notes.notes:
From Twitter wars to co-op wars! Trump-Kim mode is now live in Reagan Gorbachev.  Take control of the controversial American and North Korean leaders as they stumble, slash, and shoot their way through a global meltdown.  With the Trump-Kim nuclear summit quickly approaching, it's only fitting that these two international big shots finally get a chance to team-up for a videogame extravaganza.  Bazookas and samurai swords included.  

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11803138/0e174b379211bbd168da1d2ea3d4d47db61f1d1b.png[/img]

Trump Kim mode is Steam exclusive content and is totally FREE for owners of Reagan Gorbachev. If you don't already own the game, Reagan Gorbachev is 50% off for a limited time.

thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: Reagan Gorbachev 50% off, new survival mode added!
notes.notes:
Spring is finally here, and we're celebrating with a 50% off sale and a Reagan Gorbachev free content update!  We've added a new survival action mode where players fight to stay alive as long as possible against overwhelming odds.  Play as any of the 4 world leaders (Reagan, Gorbachev, Trump, Putin) and battle your way to the top of the leaderboards!

[img]http://www.team2bit.com/rggifs/rc%20score%20rush%20montage%20full.gif[/img]

thanks and enjoy!

Lewandowski Brothers

notes.title: Trump Putin mode free update, 50% off game!
notes.notes:
Iconic American and Russian leaders face-to-face in a global conflict. The world in a state of dystopian panic. Russian hacking. The year is 1986... or is the year 2017? Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin join our satirical Cold War action game in a new mode that let's you play as the controversial international leaders as you battle through 32 cooperative stealth levels. We can't speak for the real world, but at least in Reagan Gorbachev YOU can finally control the planet's most powerful elected leaders. Will the unlikely action stars stop their bickering and learn to work together or will the world be destroyed in a cataclysmic nuclear annihilation?   

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11803138/47bef90b2eb8e94b0e8f334b8091561681eb5040.gif[/img]

Trump Putin mode is Steam exclusive content and is totally FREE for owners of Reagan Gorbachev. If you don't already own the game, Reagan Gorbachev is 50% off for a limited time.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11803138/b309283d8af629c68bc58d20acc7371fe5dd8d3d.gif[/img]

thanks and enjoy!

notes.title: Reagan Gorbachev update now with Steam Leaderboards
notes.notes:
Did the election leave you sick of politics?  Tired of the constant partisan bickering?  Then jump in a time machine and transport yourself to a simpler time when political leaders worked together and used katanas and bazookas to solve problems.  In this latest update we've added Steam leaderboards so you can speed-run the heck out of 32 levels and then gloat when you see your name at the top of the scoreboard.  Reagan Gorbachev is a top-down action stealth game for one or two players.  Set in an alternate history timeline, world leaders Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev have been kidnapped and must work together to free themselves and stop global Armageddon.  

[img]http://www.team2bit.com/rggifs/Reagan%20Gorbachev%20speed%20run.gif[/img]

notes.title: Reagan Gorbachev Is Now Available on Xbox One and PC
notes.notes:
Indie studio Team2Bit announced today that Reagan Gorbachev, their fast-paced, top-down action-stealth shooter, is now available on Xbox One consoles and PC via Steam and the Humble Store.  

The year is 1986. Cold War leaders Ronald Reagan and Mikhail Gorbachev have been kidnapped by militant extremists. Once rivals, now the iconic presidents must set aside their differences, loosen their ties, and prepare for a blood-soaked battle. Armed only with their fists and samurai swords and poison darts and pistols and shotguns and fully automatic assault rifles and grenade launchers and miniguns and some other guns – sneak, slash or shoot your way through 32 levels of chaos in time to save the world from nuclear Armageddon. 

Reagan Gorbachev can be played by one player or two players local co-op, and is priced at $9.99 USD on all platforms.  Rated M by the ESRB and PEGI 16.
 

Xbox One: https://store.xbox.com/en-US/Xbox-One/Games/Reagan-Gorbachev/4af20167-796d-4fd8-99d5-ca855b610b8c

Steam: http://store.steampowered.com/app/364720

Humble Store: https://www.humblebundle.com/store/p/reagangorbachev_storefront


Download the press kit here: http://www.team2bit.com/press/sheet.php?p=Reagan_Gorbachev.

About Team2Bit
Team2Bit is a video game studio located in the mountains of Boulder Creek, California.  Formed by two brothers with a lifelong love for video games, harsh winters, and loud chainsaws, Team2Bit prides themselves on making unique, idiosyncratic titles, free from outside influence. Learn more at http://www.team2bit.com/
